outlooks.summary: SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS ARE EXPECTED ACROSS THE CENTRAL AND NORTHERN PLAINS ON FRIDAY. LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WIND WILL BE THE MAIN THREATS...BUT A COUPLE OF TORNADOES WILL ALSO BE POSSIBLE...MAINLY OVER A PORTION OF THE CENTRAL PLAINS.

sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: PRIMARY FEATURE OF INTEREST FRIDAY IS AN UPPER TROUGH NOW LOCATED FROM THE NRN ROCKIES INTO THE GREAT BASIN. THIS FEATURE WILL MOVE EAST AND EMERGE OVER THE CNTRL THROUGH THE NRN HIGH PLAINS FRIDAY AFTERNOON AND EVENING. A VORTICITY MAXIMUM LOCATED WITHIN THE BASE OF THE TROUGH AND CURRENTLY OVER UT WILL REACH WRN NEB AND WRN KS BY LATE AFTERNOON. AT THE SFC A LEE TROUGH/DRYLINE WILL STRETCH FROM THE NRN THROUGH SRN HIGH PLAINS. DRYLINE SHOULD SHARPEN ACROSS WRN KS INTO THE TX PANHANDLE AS A LEE LOW DEEPENS IN RESPONSE TO THE EJECTING SHORTWAVE TROUGH. A WEAK PACIFIC COLD FRONT WILL ADVANCE EWD AND MERGE WITH THE LEE TROUGH/DRYLINE ACROSS THE CNTRL AND NRN HIGH PLAINS.

sections.title: CNTRL PLAINS AREA
sections.text: AN MCS OR TWO MAY STILL BE ONGOING EARLY FRIDAY OVER PORTIONS OF THE CNTRL PLAINS. AS EARLY MORNING STORMS SHIFT TOWARD THE MS VALLEY...STAGE WILL BE SET FOR THE ATMOSPHERE TO UNDERGO STRONG DESTABILIZATION AS STEEP LAPSE RATES ARE ADVECTED ABOVE THE VERY MOIST WARM SECTOR BY A BELT OF STRONGER WINDS ALOFT ACCOMPANYING THE UPPER TROUGH. MLCAPE SHOULD INCREASE TO 2500-3500 J/KG DURING THE AFTERNOON IN AN AXIS FROM WRN KS INTO WRN NEB. STORMS WILL LIKELY DEVELOP OVER THE HIGHER TERRAIN OF WY AND NERN CO. OTHER STORMS MAY INITIATE WITHIN ZONE OF DEEP MIXING ALONG SHARPENING DRYLINE ACROSS WRN KS AS WELL AS FARTHER NORTH ALONG WEAK COLD FRONT. BACKING LOW-LEVEL WINDS EAST OF LEE LOW AND STRENGTHENING 500-MB FLOW ACCOMPANYING MID-LEVEL JET ROTATING THROUGH UPPER TROUGH BASE WILL CONTRIBUTE TO 40+ KT 0-6 KM SHEAR. SUPERCELL MODES MAY OCCUR WITH INITIAL STORMS WITH A THREAT FOR VERY LARGE HAIL. A WINDOW WILL EXIST FOR A COUPLE OF TORNADOES AS LOW-LEVEL WINDS STRENGTHEN AND BACK AND AS STORMS APPROACH AXIS OF STRONG INSTABILITY DURING THE EARLY EVENING. WITH WEAK HIGH LEVEL FLOW EXPECTED...STORMS SHOULD TREND TOWARD HP AND OUTFLOW DOMINANCE SUGGESTING ANY TORNADOES SHOULD BE RELATIVELY BRI

sections.title: NRN PLAINS
sections.text: A FEW STORM CLUSTERS WILL BE ONGOING IN THIS REGION...BUT THE ATMOSPHERE IS EXPECTED TO BECOME AT LEAST MODERATELY UNSTABLE AS EARLY ACTIVITY SHIFTS EWD. ADDITIONAL STORMS WILL LIKELY DEVELOP OVER THE HIGHER TERRAIN AND ALONG LEE TROUGH/COLD FRONT AS THE BOUNDARY LAYER DESTABILIZES. THE STRONGER WINDS ALOFT ASSOCIATED WITH THE APPROACHING UPPER TROUGH WILL REMAIN SOUTH OF THIS REGION WITH WEAK TO MODEST VERTICAL SHEAR SUPPORTIVE OF MULTICELLS. ISOLATED DAMAGING WIND GUSTS AND HAIL WILL BE THE MAIN THREATS THROUGH EARLY EVENING.

sections.title: WRN TX
sections.text: THE ATMOSPHERE IS EXPECTED TO BECOME STRONGLY UNSTABLE /2500-3500 J/KG MLCAPE/ ACROSS WRN TX...BUT WILL ALSO BE CAPPED BY A LAYER OF WARM AIR AT EML BASE. ISOLATED STORMS MAY INITIATE ACROSS WRN TX ALONG THE SHARPENING DRYLINE AS WELL AS OVER THE MOUNTAINS OF SWRN TX DURING THE LATE AFTERNOON. THIS REGION WILL REMAIN ON SRN FRINGE OF STRONGER WINDS ALOFT ACCOMPANYING THE PROGRESSIVE UPPER TROUGH. INITIAL WEAK VERTICAL SHEAR WILL UNDERGO SOME INCREASE AS THE UPPER TROUGH EMERGES OVER PLAINS AND AS THE LLJ STRENGTHENS. ANY STORMS THAT DEVELOP WILL BE CAPABLE OF LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WIND GUSTS...BUT UNCERTAINTY REGARDING STORM COVERAGE PRECLUDES MORE THAN 5% SEVERE PROBABILITIES AT THIS TIME.

sections.title: CAROLINAS
sections.text: NUMEROUS MULTICELL STORMS ARE EXPECTED TO DEVELOP IN VICINITY OF STALLED BOUNDARY ACROSS THE CAROLINAS. A FEW OF THESE STORMS MAY BECOME CAPABLE OF PRODUCING ISOLATED STRONG WIND GUSTS THROUGH EARLY EVENING. ..DIAL/COHEN.. 06/27/2014

outlooks.summary: SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS ARE EXPECTED OVER PARTS OF THE CENTRAL AND NORTHERN PLAINS. LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WIND WILL BE THE MAIN THREATS. A COUPLE OF TORNADOES ALONG WITH VERY LARGE AND DAMAGING HAIL WILL ALSO BE POSSIBLE...MAINLY OVER THE CENTRAL HIGH PLAINS.

sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: PROGRESSIVE UPPER-AIR PATTERN IS EXPECTED DOWNSTREAM FROM NEARLY ZONAL...100-120-KT 250-MB JET CORE THAT WILL EXTEND FROM ORE WWD ACROSS PORTIONS NERN PAC. MAIN SHORTWAVE TROUGH -- NOW EVIDENT IN MOISTURE-CHANNEL IMAGERY FROM WRN WY SSEWD ACROSS FOUR CORNERS AND ALONG AZ/NM BORDER -- WILL MOVE ENEWD TO ERN PORTIONS MT/WY/CO/NM BY 00Z. AS THIS OCCURS...PRIMARY/EMBEDDED VORTICITY LOBE WILL CROSS CENTRAL HIGH PLAINS. BY END OF PERIOD...SHORTWAVE TROUGH SHOULD REACH WRN PORTIONS DAKOTAS/NEB/KS...EXTENDING SWD ACROSS OK/TX PANHANDLES. STG LOW-LEVEL WAA AND MOISTURE TRANSPORT ASSOCIATED WITH THIS FEATURE ALREADY IS UNDERWAY AND WILL CONTINUE E OF SFC LEE TROUGH/DRYLINE DESCRIBED BELOW. MEANWHILE...BROAD AREA OF LOW HEIGHTS IN MID-UPPER LEVELS IS LOCATED OVER NERN MEX...TX COASTAL REGION AND AR..WITH SEVERAL EMBEDDED VORTICITY MAXIMA. AS HEIGHTS ALOFT FALL OVER GREAT PLAINS...NRN PORTION OF THIS REGIME WILL BREAK OFF AND EJECT NEWD OVER TN VALLEY REGION...CONTRIBUTING TO FAVORABLE ENVIRONMENT FOR GEN TSTMS IN ITS VICINITY. AT SFC...11Z ANALYSIS DEPICTED SFC LOWS OVER NWRN ND AND CENTRAL SD CONNECTED BY OCCLUDED FRONT...WITH WAVY/DIFFUSE PAC COLD FRONT SWWD FROM CENTRAL SD LOW THROUGH SERN

sections.title: CENTRAL-SOUTHERN GREAT PLAINS -- AFTN/EVENING
sections.text: WIDELY SCATTERED TO SCATTERED TSTMS ARE FCST TO DEVELOP THIS AFTN OVER CENTRAL HIGH PLAINS ALONG/E OF LEE TROUGH/DRYLINE AND INCREASE IN COVERAGE INTO EVENING. MEANWHILE...LATER AND MORE ISOLATED TO WIDELY SCATTERED DEVELOPMENT IS POSSIBLE WITH SWD EXTENT OVER PANHANDLES AND W TX...WHERE CAPPING INCREASES AND DEEP SHEAR GENERALLY DECREASES COMPARED TO PORTIONS KS/NEB. AT LEAST A FEW SUPERCELLS ARE LIKELY WITH ALL SVR MODES PSBL. EVENTUAL UPSCALE GROWTH INTO MIXTURE OF MULTICELLULAR/QLCS MODES WITH LATE-EVENING/OVERNIGHT MCS ACTIVITY IS EXPECTED...IN ENVIRONMENT WHERE MID-UPPER WINDS BACK TOWARD MERIDIONAL WITH HEIGHT. NOCTURNAL CLUSTERS WILL OFFER DAMAGING WIND AND OCNL HAIL...SUPPORTED BY 40-50-KT LLJ AND RELATED STORM-RELATIVE INFLOW OF HIGH-MOISTURE AIRMASS. APCH OF MID-UPPER LEVEL TROUGH WILL SPREAD INCREASING DCVA AND RELATED ASCENT/DESTABILIZATION IN MIDLEVELS OVHD...AS SFC TEMPS MAXIMIZE FROM STG LATE-JUNE DIABATIC HEATING. SFC DEW POINTS MID-UPPER 60S F ON 2500-4000-FT SFC ELEVATIONS...BENEATH STEEP MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATES OF EML...WILL CONTRIBUTE TO MLCAPE 2500-3500 J/KG...LOCALLY EXCEEDING 4000 J/KG. HEATING...ALONG WITH CONVERGENCE INVOF DRYLINE...FRONT AND OUTFLOW BOUNDARY

sections.title: NRN PLAINS -- AFTN/EVENING
sections.text: AS NOTED ABOVE...MOISTURE RETURN INTO DAKOTAS WILL BE HAMPERED RELATIVE TO FARTHER S BY ANTECEDENT/OVERNIGHT MCS ACTION. MID-UPPER WINDS AND DEEP SHEAR ALSO WILL BE WEAKER OVER NRN PLAINS COMPARED TO FARTHER S. NONETHELESS...LOW-LEVEL CONVERGENCE ALONG OCCLUDED/COLD FRONT AND LARGE-SCALE ASCENT ALOFT SHOULD SUPPORT WIDELY SCATTERED TO SCATTERED TSTMS. MIXED MODES OF MULTICELL/TRANSIENT SUPERCELL/QUASI-LINEAR CHARACTER ARE EXPECTED...WITH LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING GUSTS BEING PRIMARY CONCERNS. NOCTURNAL EXTENSION OF THIS CONVECTION MAY MERGE WITH CENTRAL PLAINS ACTIVITY OVERNIGHT.

sections.title: CAROLINAS...MIDDAY/AFTN
sections.text: SCATTERED TO LOCALLY NUMEROUS TSTMS ARE POSSIBLE -- INITIALLY IN FRONTAL ZONE AND ALONG SEA-BREEZE BOUNDARIES TO ITS S...FOLLOWED BY DEVELOPMENT RELATED TO FRESHER OUTFLOW BOUNDARIES. MOST INTENSE CELLS MAY PRODUCE STG-SVR GUSTS CAPABLE OF LOCALIZED DAMAGE. COVERAGE/INTENSITY OF CONVECTION SHOULD DIMINISH THIS EVENING...WITH STABILIZATION FROM COMBINATION OF OUTFLOWS AND DIABATIC SFC COOLING. ..EDWARDS/COOK.. 06/27/2014

outlooks.summary: SCATTERED SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS ARE EXPECTED OVER PARTS OF THE CENTRAL AND NORTHERN PLAINS. LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WIND WILL BE THE MAIN THREATS. A COUPLE OF TORNADOES ALONG WITH VERY LARGE AND DAMAGING HAIL WILL ALSO BE POSSIBLE...MAINLY OVER THE CENTRAL HIGH PLAINS. A FEW ISOLATED SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS WILL ALSO BE POSSIBLE OVER PARTS OF THE SOUTHERN HIGH PLAINS...WITH OTHER STRONG TO ISOLATED SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS OVER SOUTHERN LOUISIANA AND OVER PARTS OF THE CAROLINAS.

sections.title: CENTRAL PLAINS
sections.text: A STRONG UPPER SHORT WAVE TROUGH WELL EVIDENT IN WATER VAPOR IMAGERY IS PROGRESSING EWD ACROSS CO AND NRN NM. THIS SYSTEM WILL CONTINUE EWD INTO THE PLAINS THIS AFTERNOON AND EVENING AND ENHANCE POTENTIAL FOR SEVERE STORMS TO DEVELOP. AT THE SURFACE...AN OUTFLOW BOUNDARY EXTENDS WWD ACROSS NRN/WEST CENTRAL KS INTO NERN CO...IMMEDIATELY TO THE NORTH OF A SURFACE LOW OVER SERN CO. MORNING CONVECTION OVER THE MIDDLE MO RIVER VALLEY IS SLOWLY MOVING EWD AND BREAKS IN THE CLOUD COVER OVER PARTS OF CENTRAL HIGH PLAINS WILL PROMOTE REGIONS OF STRONGER DIABATIC HEATING THIS AFTERNOON. 12Z RAOBS AT DDC/DEN/AMA EXHIBIT VERY STEEP MID LEVEL LAPSE RATES ABOVE A WELL-DEFINED CAP/EML...WHICH IS CONTRIBUTING TO LARGE POTENTIAL INSTABILITY TO THE EAST OF THE DRY LINE IN THE PLAINS WITH MLCAPE OF 2000-3000 J/KG EXPECTED THIS AFTERNOON. LARGE SCALE ASCENT AHEAD OF THE SHORT WAVE TROUGH AND MID-LEVEL COOLING ASSOCIATED WITH THE TROUGH ARE EXPECTED TO WEAKEN THE CAP SUFFICIENTLY BY MID-AFTERNOON FOR STORMS TO DEVELOP FROM PARTS OF NERN CO INTO SWRN NEB AND WRN KS. 35-45 KT OF DEEP LAYER VERTICAL SHEAR WILL SUPPORT INITIAL SUPERCELL DEVELOPMENT...ESPECIALLY ALONG/NORTH OF THE REMNANT OUTFLOW BOUNDARY.

sections.title: NRN PLAINS
sections.text: MCV NOTED IN MOSAIC RADAR LOOPS OVER SOUTH CENTRAL SD IS EXPECTED TO LIFT SLOWLY NNEWD THIS AFTERNOON AND ENHANCE STORM DEVELOPMENT AND MAINTENANCE OVER CENTRAL/ERN SD AND INTO ERN ND. AMPLE MOISTURE IS PRESENT ACROSS THE REGION WITH SURFACE DEW POINTS IN THE MID/UPPER 60S...AND DESPITE EXTENSIVE REGIONS OF CLOUD COVER...SUFFICIENT INSTABILITY WITH MLCAPE OF 1000-1500 J/KG WILL SUPPORT STRONGER STORMS THIS AFTERNOON AND EVENING. ADDITIONAL STORMS ARE EXPECTED TO DEVELOP TO THE WEST OVER PARTS OF NERN WY AND THE WRN DAKOTAS LATER THIS AFTERNOON AND EVENING AS THE NRN PARTS OF THE WRN US TROUGH PROGRESSES EWD ACROSS THE NRN ROCKIES....WITH A THREAT FOR A FEW SEVERE STORMS.

sections.title: SRN HIGH PLAINS
sections.text: A STEEP LAPSE RATE ENVIRONMENT ASSOCIATED WITH THE EML AND CAPPING INVERSION IS PRESENT ACROSS THE AREA. WITH STRONGER FORCING FOR ASCENT DECREASING WITH SWD EXTENT ACROSS THE SRN HIGH PLAINS...MORE ISOLATED STORM COVERAGE IS EXPECTED SOUTH OF THE TX PANHANDLE INTO SWRN TX. STRONGER CELLS WILL BE CAPABLE OF PRODUCING LARGE HAIL AND STRONG WIND GUSTS LATE THIS AFTERNOON AND EVENING.

sections.title: SERN TX/SRN LA
sections.text: VEERING LOW-LEVEL WIND PROFILES ENHANCED BY A SUBTLE E-W SURFACE BOUNDARY ACROSS SERN TX/SRN LA MAY PROMOTE DEVELOPMENT OF TRANSIENT SUPERCELL STRUCTURES AS STORMS DEVELOP EWD IN ASSOCIATION WITH AN UPPER TROUGH OVER THE SABINE VALLEY. A BRIEF TORNADO OR STRONG WIND GUST MAY ACCOMPANY STRONGER CELLS INTO THE AFTERNOON.

sections.title: CAROLINAS
sections.text: SCATTERED TO LOCALLY NUMEROUS TSTMS ARE POSSIBLE -- INITIALLY IN FRONTAL ZONE AND ALONG SEA-BREEZE BOUNDARIES TO ITS S...FOLLOWED BY DEVELOPMENT RELATED TO FRESHER OUTFLOW BOUNDARIES. MOST INTENSE CELLS MAY PRODUCE STG-SVR GUSTS CAPABLE OF LOCALIZED DAMAGE. COVERAGE/INTENSITY OF CONVECTION SHOULD DIMINISH THIS EVENING...WITH STABILIZATION FROM COMBINATION OF OUTFLOWS AND DIABATIC SFC COOLING. ..WEISS/MARSH.. 06/27/2014

outlooks.summary: SCATTERED SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS ARE EXPECTED OVER PARTS OF THE CENTRAL AND NORTHERN PLAINS. LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WIND WILL BE THE MAIN THREATS. A COUPLE OF TORNADOES ALONG WITH VERY LARGE AND DAMAGING HAIL WILL ALSO BE POSSIBLE...MAINLY OVER THE CENTRAL HIGH PLAINS. A FEW ISOLATED SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS WILL ALSO BE POSSIBLE OVER PARTS OF THE SOUTHERN HIGH PLAINS...WITH OTHER STRONG TO ISOLATED SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS OVER SOUTHERN LOUISIANA AND SOUTHEAST TEXAS...THE MIDDLE AND UPPER MISSISSIPPI VALLEY AND OVER PARTS OF THE CAROLINAS. HAVE INTRODUCED LOW SVR WIND/HAIL PROBS ACROSS ERN IA/SWRN WI/NWRN IL/NERN MO WHERE DESTABILIZATION HAS OCCURRED DOWNSTREAM OF CURRENT TSTMS. DESPITE WEAK SHEAR PROFILES...A MODERATELY UNSTABLE AIR MASS /SBCAPE OF 2000 J/KG/ COMBINED WITH HIGH PW AND MODESTLY STEEP LOW LEVEL LAPSE RATES...WILL RESULT IN A CONTINUED RISK FOR ISOLATED DAMAGING GUSTS. REF MCD 1172 FOR THE LATEST SHORT-TERM DETAILS IN THIS AREA. HAVE MAINTAINED CATEGORICAL SLIGHT RISK ACROSS NRN PLAINS IN ADVANCE OF REMNANT MCV OVER NERN SD WHERE LATEST MESOANALYSIS AND VISIBLE IMAGERY REFLECTS REDUCED CINH AND DEEPENING CU FIELD. LATEST RADAR CAPPI DISPLAY SHOWS SOME STRONGER CELLS OVER SER

outlooks.summary: SCATTERED SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS WILL PERSIST OVER PORTIONS OF THE CENTRAL AND NORTHERN PLAINS THIS EVENING. LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WIND WILL BE THE MAIN THREATS. OTHER MORE ISOLATED SEVERE STORMS REMAIN POSSIBLE FROM WESTERN AND CENTRAL KANSAS AS WELL AS THE TEXAS AND OKLAHOMA PANHANDLES AND WESTERN TEXAS THROUGH MID EVENING.

sections.title: NEB AND SD
sections.text: LARGE COMPLEX OF STORMS PERSISTS FROM WRN SD THROUGH WRN NEB. MOST ORGANIZED STORMS INCLUDING A BOWING SQUALL LINE EXISTS ACROSS WRN NEB WHERE STORMS ARE INTERACTING WITH STRONGER MID-LEVEL WINDS ACCOMPANYING AN EJECTING SHORTWAVE TROUGH. THESE STORMS WILL LIKELY CONTINUE NEWD THROUGH CNTRL NEB WHERE THE ATMOSPHERE REMAINS VERY UNSTABLE WITH 2000-3000 J/KG MLCAPE. DAMAGING WIND AND LARGE HAIL ARE LIKELY NEXT FEW HOURS AS THESE STORMS MOVE NEWD THROUGH NEB. SEVERE THREAT DOES NOT APPEAR QUITE AS ROBUST ACROSS WRN SD WHERE THE SHEAR-INSTABILITY PARAMETER SPACE IS MORE MODEST. NEVERTHELESS A FEW INSTANCES OF LOCALLY STRONG TO DAMAGING WIND GUSTS AND HAIL REMAIN POSSIBLE NEXT 2-3 HOURS. IT IS ALSO POSSIBLE THAT MORE ORGANIZED STORMS OVER NEB MAY EVENTUALLY SPREAD INTO SERN SD LATER THIS EVENING.

sections.title: WRN AND CNTRL KS...AND THE OK AND TX PANHANDLES
sections.text: STORMS ARE FINALLY DEVELOPING ALONG THE DRYLINE OVER WRN KS JUST SOUTH OF THE GOODLAND AREA IN RESPONSE TO WHAT APPEARS TO BE INCREASING DEEPER FORCING FOR ASCENT ASSOCIATED WITH AN EJECTING SHORTWAVE TROUGH. THESE STORMS MAY INTENSIFY AS THEY MOVE INTO THE AXIS OF STRONG INSTABILITY AND WHERE DEEP SHEAR FROM 35-40 KT IS SUPPORTIVE OF SUPERCELLS. A SMALL WINDOW MAY EXIST AS THE LLJ STRENGTHENS FOR A TORNADO OR TWO OVER WRN KS BEFORE THE BOUNDARY LAYER DECOUPLES...BUT PRIMARY THREAT WILL BE LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WIND GUSTS. THE 00Z RAOB FROM DODGE CITY SHOWS A STRONG CAPPING INVERSION WHICH SUGGESTS STORMS MAY HAVE A DIFFICULT TIME DEVELOPING MUCH FARTHER SOUTH. HOWEVER...IF STORMS CAN ORGANIZE A COLD POOL THE STRENGTHENING LLJ INTERACTING WITH THE CONVECTIVE GUST FRONT MAY CONTRIBUTE TO ENOUGH CONVERGENCE TO SUSTAIN STORMS INTO CNTRL KS.

sections.title: WRN TX
sections.text: ISOLATED STORMS THAT DEVELOPED ALONG THE DRYLINE WILL PERSIST OVER WRN TX NEXT COUPLE HOURS AND LIKELY PRODUCE LARGE HAIL AND LOCALIZED STRONG WIND GUSTS. HOWEVER...THIS ACTIVITY SHOULD EVENTUALLY SUCCUMB TO THE CAP AS THE BOUNDARY LAYER STABILIZES. ..DIAL.. 06/28/2014

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A FEW STRONG TO SEVERE STORMS WILL BE POSSIBLE THROUGH THE AFTERNOON. STRONG/LOCALLY DAMAGING WINDS AND A TORNADO OR TWO COULD ACCOMPANY STRONGER STORMS. THE THREAT SHOULD REMAIN ISOLATED AND A WATCH IS NOT EXPECTED AT THIS TIME...BUT TRENDS WILL BE MONITORED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A THUNDERSTORM HAS DEVELOPED NEAR THE SABINE RIVER IN FAR SOUTHWEST LA LATE THIS MORNING ALONG A W-E ORIENTED SFC BOUNDARY/TROUGH IN THE VICINITY OF A WEAK MID/UPPER LEVEL SHORTWAVE TROUGH /NOTED IN LATEST WV IMAGERY/ TRACKING EWD ACROSS SRN TX AND THE WESTERN GULF OF MEXICO. 12Z RAOB FROM LCH SHOWED A VERTICALLY VEERING LOW LEVEL WIND PROFILE WITH 0-1 KM SRH NEAR 250 M2/S2 IN A TROPICAL AIRMASS WITH MEAN MIXING RATIOS NEAR 14 G/KG AND SBCAPE AROUND 1500 J/KG. THE THREAT SHOULD CONTINUE TO THE N/NE ACROSS SRN/SERN LA INTO THE AFTERNOON AS THE UPPER TROUGH CONTINUES EWD. GIVEN FAVORABLE LOW LEVEL SHEAR PROFILES AND MOISTURE PROFILES...A TORNADO OR TWO CANNOT BE RULED OUT...ESPECIALLY IN THE VICINITY OF THE SFC BOUNDARY/TROUGH. GENERALLY WEAK FLOW ALOFT AND SOME DRIER AIR AROUND 850-700 MB COUPLED WITH PW VALUES NEAR 2 INCHES COULD LEAD TO A FEW STRONGER WIND GUSTS AS WELL. GIVEN LACK OF STRONGER DEEP LAYER SHEAR AND ONLY WEAK FORCING ASSOCIATED WITH THE UPPER SHORTWAVE IMPULSE...CONVECTION SHOULD REMAIN ISOLATED. A WATCH IS NOT EXPECTED AT THIS TIME...BUT TRENDS WILL CONTINUE TO BE MONITORED.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THUNDERSTORMS WILL INCREASE IN COVERAGE OVER THE NEXT 1-2 HOURS ACROSS SE WY AND NE CO...AND TRACK E/NE TOWARD WRN NEB AND NW KS. SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS CAPABLE OF LARGE HAIL AND STRONG/DAMAGING WINDS WILL BE THE MAIN THREAT. BUT...A TORNADO OR TWO ALSO IS POSSIBLE...ESPECIALLY ACROSS PARTS OF CO INTO SW NEB AND NW KS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: THUNDERSTORMS WERE DEVELOPING ALONG THE HIGHER TERRAIN FROM SE WY INTO CENTRAL CO EARLY THIS AFTERNOON AS A SHORTWAVE IMPULSE ASSOCIATED WITH NEGATIVELY TILTED UPPER TROUGH EJECTS E/NE INTO THE HIGH PLAINS. MOSTLY SUNNY SKIES HAVE ALLOWED TEMPERATURES TO WARM INTO THE MID/UPPER 70S OVER THE HIGH PLAINS EAST OF THE ROCKIES. 17Z MESOANALYSIS INDICATED ONLY WEAK CINH REMAINING FROM NE CO/SE WY INTO WRN NEB...WHERE COOLING MIDLEVEL TEMPERATURES HAVE RESULTED IN STEEPENING MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATES /GREATER THAN 7.5 DEG C PER KM/. ADDITIONAL HEATING WILL ERODE REMAINING CAP AND MLCAPE VALUES AOA 2000 J/KG ARE EXPECTED. WHILE SOME STORMS MAY MOVE OFF HIGHER TERRAIN AND BE MAINTAINED INTO THE HIGH PLAINS GIVEN ADEQUATE BOUNDARY LAYER MOISTURE AND STRONG DEEP LAYER SHEAR...ADDITIONAL DEVELOPMENT MAY BE FOCUSED ALONG A GENERALLY W-E ORIENTED REMNANT OUTFLOW BOUNDARY FROM NRN/CENTRAL CO INTO E-CENTRAL CO AND NW KS...AND ALONG A SFC TROUGH EXTENDING NWD FROM SE CO SFC LOW INTO ERN WY/WRN NEB. STORMS MAY INITIALLY REMAIN SEMI-DISCRETE BUT ARE EXPECTED TO EVOLVE INTO CLUSTERS AS THEY TRACK E/NE. DAMAGING WINDS AND LARGE HAIL WILL BE THE MAIN THREATS...BUT A TORNADO IS POSSIBLE AS WELL...ESPECIALLY WITH ANY STORMS THAT DEVELOP IN THE VICINITY OF THE OUTFLOW BOUNDARY ACROSS CO INTO FAR NW KS. TRENDS WILL BE MONITORED FOR A POSSIBLE WW BY 20Z.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: STRONG TO BRIEFLY SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS WILL CONTINUE THROUGH THE AFTERNOON. A WATCH IS CURRENTLY NOT ANTICIPATED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: THUNDERSTORMS HAVE DEVELOPED ALONG A SOUTHWARD MOVING FRONT ACROSS NORTHERN NORTH CAROLINA AND ALONG A SEA BREEZE ACROSS EASTERN NORTH CAROLINA. ADDITIONAL THUNDERSTORMS HAVE DEVELOPED ACROSS PORTIONS OF SOUTH CAROLINA...WITH THE STRONGEST NEAR CHESTERFIELD/KERSHAW/LANCASTER COUNTIES. THE ENVIRONMENT ACROSS THE HIGHLIGHTED AREA IS CHARACTERIZED BY STRONG INSTABILITY /2000-3000 J/KG/ AND WEAKENING DEEP-LAYER SHEAR /AT OR BELOW 30 KNOTS/. THE PRESENCE OF STRONG INSTABILITY WILL SUPPORT STRONG TO BRIEFLY SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS...ALTHOUGH THE MODEST/WEAKENING DEEP-LAYER SHEAR WILL ACT TO LIMIT WIDESPREAD/ORGANIZED NATURE OF THE SEVERE THREAT. THE STRONGEST THUNDERSTORMS WILL BE CAPABLE OF PRODUCING HAIL AND ISOLATED WIND DAMAGE...BUT THE BRIEF/LOCALIZED NATURE OF THE THREAT SHOULD PRECLUDE THE NEED FOR A WATCH.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: ISOLATED STRONG THUNDERSTORMS ARE POSSIBLE THE REMAINDER OF THE AFTERNOON. A FEW GUSTY TO LOCALLY DAMAGING WIND GUSTS WILL BE POSSIBLE WITH THE STRONGER STORMS. A WATCH IS NOT EXPECTED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: THUNDERSTORMS SHOULD CONTINUE TO TRACK EWD ACROSS ERN IA/FAR NE MO THIS AFTERNOON AS A SHORTWAVE IMPULSE LIFTS NEWD TOWARD THE UPPER MS VALLEY. THE DOWNSTREAM AIRMASS IS MODERATELY UNSTABLE /SBCAPE AROUND 2000 J/KG/ WITH STEEPENING LOW LEVEL LAPSE RATES PRESENT WITH EWD EXTENT. WEAK DEEP LAYER SHEAR AND PW VALUES AOA 1.5 INCHES...COUPLED WITH SOME DRY AIR IN THE 850-700 MB LAYER /PER NAM AND RAP FORECAST SOUNDINGS/ WILL FAVOR OCCASIONALLY STRONG/LOCALLY DAMAGING WIND GUSTS. SOME SMALL HAIL MAY ALSO BE POSSIBLE WITH STRONGER UPDRAFTS. HOWEVER...POOR MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATES AND WEAK 0-6 KM BULK SHEAR WILL LIMIT LONGEVITY OF STRONGER UPDRAFTS AND OVERALL STORM ORGANIZATION...AND A WATCH IS NOT ANTICIPATED.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: STRONG THUNDERSTORMS ARE DEVELOPING ACROSS PORTIONS OF THE AREA...AND WILL CONTINUE TO INCREASE IN COVERAGE AND INTENSITY THROUGH THE AFTERNOON. A WATCH IS CURRENTLY NOT ANTICIPATED...HOWEVER HAIL APPROACHING 1 INCH AND WINDS NEAR 60 MPH CANNOT BE RULED OUT.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: THUNDERSTORMS ARE DEVELOPING/INCREASING IN COVERAGE AHEAD OF A COMPACT SHORT-WAVE TROUGH/MESOSCALE CONVECTIVE VORTEX CURRENTLY LIFTING NORTHEAST ACROSS NORTHERN SOUTH DAKOTA. THE AIR MASS AHEAD OF THIS MESOSCALE CONVECTIVE VORTEX HAS BECOME UNSTABLE WITH MLCAPE VALUES UP TO 1500 J/KG. GIVEN THE PRESENCE OF MLCAPE VALUES AROUND 1500 J/KG...ISOLATED LARGE HAIL AND STRONG WINDS WILL BE POSSIBLE WITH THE STRONGEST THUNDERSTORMS. DESPITE THIS INSTABILITY...MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES ARE GENERALLY LESS THAN 6.5 C/KG...WHICH SHOULD ACT TO LIMIT THE THREAT FOR VERY LARGE HAIL. ADDITIONALLY...WEAK DEEP-LAYER SHEAR SHOULD ACT TO LIMIT THE WIDESPREAD/ORGANIZED NATURE OF ANY SEVERE THREAT. THE EXCEPTION TO THIS WOULD BE IF THUNDERSTORM OUTFLOWS CAN CONGEAL/ORGANIZE ON A MESO-BETA SCALE WHICH COULD LEAD TO AN INCREASED THREAT FOR ORGANIZED WIND DAMAGE. GIVEN THE ANTICIPATED BRIEF/ISOLATED NATURE OF ANY SEVERE THREAT...A WATCH IS CURRENTLY NOT EXPECTED.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SEVERE THREAT IS INCREASING ACROSS SW NEB AND NW KS. UNCERTAINTY EXISTS WITH REGARDS TO THE SOUTHERN EXTENT OF THE GREATEST THREAT ACROSS WRN KS...BUT A FEW STORMS SHOULD DEVELOP BY 22-00Z. LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS WILL BE THE MAIN THREAT...BUT A TORNADO OR TWO IS ALSO POSSIBLE.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: SURFACE HEATING HAS BEEN LIMITED BY CLOUD COVER MOST OF THE DAY WITH TEMPERATURES CURRENTLY ONLY IN THE UPPER 70S TO NEAR 80. LATEST VIS IMAGERY SHOWS BETTER CU FIELD ACROSS SW NEB/NW KS WITH PERHAPS A FEW CU DEVELOPING IN THINNER/BROKEN CLOUDINESS FURTHER SOUTH TOWARD DDC IN SW KS. 18Z RAOB FROM DDC INDICATED A STOUT CAP STILL IN PLACE WITH A WARM NOSE OF 24 C AROUND 800 MB. MIDLEVEL TEMPERATURES SHOULD DECREASE SOME WITH TIME AS SHORTWAVE IMPULSE CONTINUES TO EJECT E/NE INTO THE CENTRAL PLAINS AND WITH ANOTHER COUPLE HOURS OF HEATING...CAPPING SHOULD DECREASE SOME. HOWEVER...CONFIDENCE IS LOW IN HOW FAR SOUTH GREATER SEVERE THREAT MAY EXTEND ACROSS WRN KS. MOIST LOW LEVEL UPSLOPE SELY FLOW AHEAD OF THE SFC LOW AND DRYLINE COUPLED WITH INCREASING DEEP FORCING FOR ASCENT AHEAD OF THE SHORTWAVE IMPULSE MAY BE SUFFICIENT FOR A FEW STORMS TO DEVELOP IN THE VICINITY OF THE DRYLINE/LEE TROUGH ACROSS NW KS INTO SW NEB. VERY STEEP LAPSE RATES ATOP MID 60S DEWPOINTS HAS RESULTED IN A STRONGLY UNSTABLE AIRMASS. DAMAGING WINDS AND LARGE HAIL WILL BE POSSIBLE AS ANY UPDRAFT THAT DEVELOPS AND BREAKS THE CAP SHOULD BE VERY ROBUST. ADDITIONALLY...BACKED LOW LEVEL FLOW VEERING WITH HEIGHT ON THE NORTHEAST SIDE OF THE LEE SFC LOW WILL MAXIMIZE LOW LEVEL HODOGRAPHS IN THIS AREA...AND A FEW TORNADOES WILL BE POSSIBLE. AS THE LOW LEVEL JET INCREASES THIS EVENING INTO TONIGHT...SEMI-DISCRETE CONVECTION SHOULD GROW UPSCALE INTO FORWARD PROPAGATING STORM CLUSTER/QLCS.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: STRONG TO SEVERE STORMS POSING AN INCREASING CHANCE FOR DAMAGING WINDS AND SOME HAIL ARE EXPECTED TO EVOLVE ENEWD FROM THE NEB PANHANDLE ACROSS N-CENTRAL NEB AND SWRN AND SRN SD THIS EVENING. A SEVERE THUNDERSTORM WATCH MAY BE NEEDED ACROSS THESE AREAS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A COMPLEX SFC PATTERN EXITS ACROSS THE CENTRAL PLAINS LATE THIS AFTERNOON AS A RELATIVELY STRONG AND COMPACT MID-LEVEL DISTURBANCE AND ASSOCIATED 30-50KT WIND MAX EJECT NEWD FROM CO/WY. WIDESPREAD STRONG TO SEVERE STORMS HAVE BEEN CONSOLIDATING NEAR SFC LOW IN NERN CO...AND ALONG INVERTED TROUGH EXTENDING NEWD ACROSS THE NEB PANHANDLE. LATEST INDICATIONS ARE THAT THE MASS OF CONVECTION WILL SPREAD NEWD INTO MODERATELY UNSTABLE AIRMASS SITUATED ACROSS NEB/SD BORDER...SOUTH OF A WEAK WARM FRONT OVER S-CNTRL SD. GIVEN CONTINUATION OF LARGE SCALE ASCENT SPREADING ACROSS THE WARM SECTOR...AND FAVORABLE ALIGNMENT OF POTENTIAL DEVELOPING CONVECTIVE COLD POOL TO THE STRONGER SWLY FLOW ALOFT...EXPECT ORGANIZED STORMS...OR A COMPLEX OF STORMS...TO EVOLVE AND SPREAD NEWD ACROSS THE REGION. GREATEST THREAT SHOULD BE STRONG TO DAMAGING WINDS BUT SHEAR AND INSTABILITY WILL ALSO SUPPORT EMBEDDED SUPERCELLS WITH THE CHANCE FOR HAIL AND EVEN AN ISOLATED TORNADO.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: ISOLATED SUPERCELL DEVELOPMENT IS POSSIBLE IN THE NEXT 1-2 HRS...WITH A PRIMARY THREAT OF DAMAGING WIND AND LARGE HAIL. THIS AREA IS BEING MONITORED FOR POSSIBLE WATCH ISSUANCE.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: LATEST VIS IMAGERY SHOWS TCU DEVELOPMENT ALONG A DRYLINE RUNNING WEST OF A MRF-INK-PVW LINE...WHERE TEMPERATURES HAVE HEATED TO ABOVE 100F. UPPER 50S-LOW 60S DEWPOINTS HAVE ALLOWED STRONG INSTABILITY TO DEVELOP IN THIS REGION...WITH SBCAPE OF 2500-4000 J/KG IN PLACE PER RECENT MESOANALYSIS. WHILE LOW-LEVEL FLOW IS RELATIVELY WEAK...STRONG NLY MID-HIGH LEVEL FLOW...AS INDICATED BY SWD STREAMING ANVILS FROM INCIPIENT STORMS...IS RESULTING IN SUFFICIENT EFFECTIVE SHEAR FOR SUPERCELL DEVELOPMENT. AS A RESULT...DEVELOPING CONVECTION IS EXPECTED TO EVOLVE INTO ISOLATED TO SCATTERED SUPERCELLS...CAPABLE OF PRODUCING DAMAGING WIND AND LARGE HAIL. GIVEN RECENT TRENDS...AREAS NEAR LBB AND SWD ARE LIKELY TO SEE DEVELOPMENT FIRST. CU IS NOT AS ROBUST AT THE MOMENT ACROSS AREAS FURTHER NORTH INTO THE TX/OK PANHANDLES...BUT DEVELOPMENT IS POSSIBLE IN THESE REGIONS TOWARD EVENING AS ADDITIONAL HEATING WEAKENS THE CAP AND THE AREA RECEIVES A GLANCING BLOW FROM THE EJECTING TROUGH TO THE NORTH. GIVEN THE POTENTIAL FOR ISOLATED TO SCATTERED SUPERCELLS...ONE OR MORE WATCHES MAY BE ISSUED IN THE NEXT 1-2 HRS TO COVER THIS THREAT.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: NUMEROUS SEVERE STORMS ARE DEVELOPING ENEWD INTO WESTERN AND NRN PORTIONS OF TORNADO WATCH 361. EXPECT TORNADO...LARGE HAIL AND HIGH WIND POTENTIAL TO PERSIST...ESPECIALLY ACROSS NRN PORTIONS OF THE WATCH...FROM NWRN KS INTO SWRN AND S-CNTRL NEB OVER THE NEXT 1-2 HOURS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A VOLATILE AIRMASS CHARACTERIZED BY AREAS OF MLCAPE TO 4000 J/KG EXISTS TO THE EAST OF ONGOING STORMS...STRONG COLD POOL AND SFC LOW/DRYLINE NOW MOVING FROM ERN CO INTO WRN KS. IN ADDITION TO STORM-SCALE FORCING ON THE ADVANCING COLD POOL...AND MIXING SOUTH ALONG THE DRYLINE...MODERATE TO STRONG FORCING FOR ASCENT ASSOCIATED WITH THE PASSAGE OF MID-LEVEL SHORT WAVE TROUGH WILL CONTINUE TO DRIVE SEVERE TSTMS ACROSS THE WATCH AREA THIS EVENING. ACTIVITY HAS BEEN ORGANIZING INTO BOWING LINE SEGMENTS FROM NWRN INTO SWRN NEB WHERE BACKED LOW LEVEL FLOW WAS CONTRIBUTING TO A LOW LEVEL MAXIMUM IN STORM-RELATIVE FLOW AND EFFECTIVE SRH ON THE ORDER OF 200 M2/S2. DAMAGING WINDS WILL LIKELY ACCOMPANY THE WELL-FORMED BOWING SEGMENTS WHILE TORNADO POTENTIAL MAY BE GREATER WITH BREAKS IN LINE SEGMENTS AND POSSIBLY EVOLVING BOOK-END VORTICES. THIS POTENTIAL WILL MOST LIKELY SPREAD ACROSS NRN AREAS OF THE WATCH OVER THE NEXT 1-2 HOURS WHILE LOCATIONS FARTHER SOUTH CONTINUE TO HAVE A CHANCE FOR MORE ISOLATED STORMS INITIATING NEAR THE DRYLINE.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: EARLIER EXTENSIVE/WIDESPREAD THUNDERSTORM DEVELOPMENT ACROSS MUCH OF WATCH 360...FROM SERN WY ACROSS NEB PANHANDLE AND ERN CO...HAS EFFECTIVELY STABILIZED MOST AREAS. EXPECT THIS WATCH TO BE CANCELED/CLEARED IN MOST AREAS PRIOR TO SCHEDULED EXPIRATION AT 0100 UTC/7PM MDT.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: WIDESPREAD AND ROBUST THUNDERSTORM DEVELOPMENT FROM THE FRONT RANGE EASTWARD WAS AIDED BY THE PASSAGE OF A COMPACT MID/UPPER LEVEL TROUGH DURING THE LATE AFTERNOON. THIS CONVECTION HAS EFFECTIVELY OVERTURNED AND STABILIZED THE AIRMASS ACROSS SERN WY AND MUCH OF ERN CO WITH RAIN-COOLED OUTFLOW NOW SPREADING SOUTH OF THE WATCH AREA AND INTO PUEBLO/OTERO COUNTIES IN CO. WITH THE POSSIBLE EXCEPTION OF A SMALL AREA OF NERN CO...FROM LOGAN TO PHILLIPS/SEDGWICK COUNTIES WHERE RESIDUAL STRONGER INSTABILITY REMAINS THAT COULD STILL SUPPORT POTENT STORMS WITH ISOLATED DOWNBURST WINDS AND LARGE HAIL...THE SEVERE WEATHER THREAT HAS DIMINISHED ACROSS THE BULK OF WATCH 360.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: NUMEROUS STRONG TO SEVERE STORMS CONTINUE ACROSS WRN SD AND WERE ALSO MOVING FROM WRN INTO CNTRL NEB THIS EVENING. A NEW SEVERE TSTM WATCH IS BEING ISSUED FOR PARTS OF CNTRL AND ERN NEB.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: STRONG FORWARD PROPAGATING BOWING SEGMENT OF CONVECTION WILL SPREAD INTO SCNTRL AND CNTRL PORTIONS OF NEB OVER THE NEXT 1-2 HOURS AND A NEW SEVERE TSTM WATCH IS BEING ISSUED AHEAD OF THESE STORMS THAT ARE LIKELY TO PRODUCE STRONG TO SEVERE WINDS. ELSEWHERE ACROSS WATCH 362...NUMEROUS STORMS IN LOOSELY ORGANIZED LINE SEGMENTS WERE MOVING MORE SLOWLY EAST ACROSS NORTHWEST NEB AND WRN SD. GIVEN MODEST INSTABILITY EXISTING AHEAD OF THIS CONVECTION...AND CONTINUING SUPPORT FOR LARGE SCALE ASCENT FROM EJECTING SHORTWAVE TROUGH MOVING NEWD FROM CO/WRN KS...EXPECT SOME SEVERE HAIL/WIND POTENTIAL TO PERSIST...ALBEIT MORE ISOLATED DUE TO SOMEWHAT WEAKER DEEP SHEAR AND INSTABILITY WHEN COMPARED TO POINTS SOUTH.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: ISOLATED SEVERE THREAT CONTINUES...PARTICULARLY ACROSS NRN PART OF WW 363. THE THREAT IS EXPECTED TO GENERALLY DIMINISH WITH TIME ACROSS MOST OF THE WATCH AS NOCTURNAL COOLING COMMENCES. ONGOING ELEVATED STORMS WILL CONTINUE TO BE MONITORED AS THEY MOVE INTO THE TX PANHANDLE.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: AT 0120Z...A SUPERCELL IS ONGOING ACROSS FLOYD COUNTY TX...BUT OTHER DEEP CONVECTION HAS WEAKENED FURTHER TO THE SOUTH ACROSS WW 363. A MIXTURE OF SURFACE-BASED CU AND ELEVATED CONVECTIVE SHOWERS IS STILL PRESENT FROM LBB SWD TO NEAR FST AND THERE IS SOME LINGERING THREAT OF INTENSIFICATION IN THIS AREA...BUT THE WINDOW OF OPPORTUNITY FOR ROBUST SFC-BASED STORMS IS CLOSING WITH THE ONSET OF DIURNAL COOLING. PARTS OF THE WATCH MAY BE CLEARED SHORTLY ACROSS THESE AREAS IF NO REINTENSIFICATION OCCURS. IN THE FAR NRN PART OF THE WATCH...CONVECTION HAS BEEN INCREASING SOUTH OF AMA...POTENTIALLY ASSOCIATED WITH LARGER-SCALE ASCENT AHEAD OF A SUBTLE VORT MAX OVER NRN NM. THESE STORMS ARE LIKELY SOMEWHAT ELEVATED...BASED ON THEIR ORIGIN AND RELATIVELY RAPID ENELY MOVEMENT...BUT MAY PRODUCE SOME HAIL...ESPECIALLY IF THEY CAN BECOME CLOSER TO SURFACE-BASED AND TAP GREATER BUOYANCY. AREAS OF THE TX PANHANDLE WILL CONTINUE TO BE MONITORED FOR POTENTIAL WW ISSUANCE IF THESE STORMS INTENSIFY...BUT THE SEVERE THREAT WILL LIKELY REMAIN ISOLATED AT BEST AS LONG AS THE ACTIVITY REMAINS ELEVATED. ..DEAN.. 06/28/2014 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: ALTHOUGH STRONG TO ISOLATED SEVERE STORMS WITH HAIL AND WIND MAY PERSIST ACROSS PARTS OF WRN KS...THE TORNADO THREAT CONTINUES TO DIMINISH ACROSS WATCH 361 FOR WRN KS AND A SMALL PORTION OF SWRN NEB. THE REMAINDER OF THE WATCH AREA WILL BE ALLOWED TO EXPIRE AT THE TOP OF THE HOUR.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: INTENSE STORMS PERSIST ALONG AND IMMEDIATELY BEHIND COLD-POOL OUTFLOW EXTENDING FROM NORTH OF DDC NEWD TO THE NEB BORDER. NEW UPDRAFTS HAVE RECENTLY DEVELOPED AMIDST THE HOT AND UNSTABLE AIRMASS ACROSS SWRN KS. GIVEN ABUNDANT INSTABILITY AND CONTINUING BACKGROUND FORCING FOR ASCENT...IN ADDITION TO AN INCREASE IN MASS AND MOISTURE FLUX ON STRENGTHENING NOCTURNAL LOW-LEVEL JET...EXPECT DEEP CONVECTION TO PERSIST DESPITE RELATIVELY HIGH INHIBITION AND WARM TEMPERATURES ALOFT. WHILE TORNADO POTENTIAL APPEARS TO BE ON THE WANE...THE CHANCE FOR ISOLATED STRONG DOWNDRAFTS...HAIL...AND VERY HEAVY RAIN WILL PERSIST WITH STORMS REGENERATING ALONG THE SWRN FLANK OF DEEPER COLD POOL ACROSS WRN KS LATE THIS EVENING. OVERALL SEVERE POTENTIAL DOES NOT APPEAR TO WARRANT AN ADDITIONAL WATCH AT THIS TIME.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: AN ISOLATED LARGE HAIL THREAT WILL PERSIST FOR THE NEXT SEVERAL HOURS. WW ISSUANCE IS CONSIDERED UNLIKELY DUE TO THE ISOLATED NATURE OF THE THREAT...BUT TRENDS WILL CONTINUE TO BE MONITORED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: AT 0230Z...AN INTENSE STORM THAT HAD RECENTLY PRODUCED GOLFBALL-SIZED HAIL WAS MOVING RAPIDLY INTO GRAY/WHEELER COUNTIES IN TX. WHILE THIS STORM IS LIKELY SOMEWHAT ELEVATED...IT DISPLAYS CHARACTERISTICS OF A LEFT-MOVING SUPERCELL AND WILL LIKELY CONTINUE TO POSE A SEVERE HAIL RISK AS IT MOVES INTO WRN OK...GIVEN VERY STEEP LAPSE RATES NOTED IN 00Z AMA/OUN SOUNDINGS AND FAVORABLE WIND PROFILES BEING ENHANCED BY AN INCREASING LOW-LEVEL JET. OTHER GENERALLY WEAKER STORMS ARE ONGOING FURTHER SOUTH...THOUGH INTENSIFICATION IN THIS AREA IS POSSIBLE GIVEN STRONG MUCAPE OF 2500-3500 J/KG FOR PARCELS ROOTED AROUND 850 MB. GIVEN ELEVATED NATURE OF CONVECTION AND ISOLATED COVERAGE OF SEVERE THREAT THUS FAR...IT IS NOT CLEAR THAT WW ISSUANCE WILL BE NECESSARY DOWNSTREAM OF WW 363...THOUGH TRENDS WILL CONTINUE TO BE MONITORED. SEVERE HAIL WILL CONTINUE TO BE THE PRIMARY THREAT.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: ISOLATED SEVERE THUNDERSTORM WIND AND MARGINAL SEVERE HAIL POTENTIAL MAY PERSIST ACROSS PARTS OF WATCHES 362 AND 364 BUT OVERALL THREAT FOR MORE SUBSTANTIAL SEVERE HAS BEEN DECREASING LATE THIS EVENING ACROSS WRN SD AND CNTRL NEB. EXPECT WATCHES WILL BE CANCELED PRIOR TO EXPIRATION IN MOST AREAS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: LEADING EDGE OF A WELL-FORMED AND EXTENSIVE ARC OF DEEP CONVECTION WAS SPREADING NORTH-NORTHEASTWARD TOWARD THE CENTRAL NEB/SD BORDER AT ABOUT 45KT. THIS SYSTEM WAS BEING SUSTAINED BY WELL-DEFINED MID-LEVEL DISTURBANCE AND ASSOCIATED 40-50KT SPEED MAX EJECTING OUT OF A LARGER SCALE TROUGH ACROSS THE ROCKIES. TRAILING SEGMENT OF THE BOW...ACROSS SCNTRL NEB...HAS WEAKENED CONSIDERABLY WHILE LEADING EDGE NEARING THE NEB/SD BORDER...CONTINUES TO INGEST GREATER INSTABILITY AND EXHIBIT STRONGER REFLECTIVITY. GUSTS ALONG THIS LEADING EDGE COULD STILL TOP 50KT BUT EXPECT DOWNWARD TREND AS CONVECTION ENCOUNTERS GREATER BOUNDARY LAYER STABILIZATION WITH NIGHTTIME COOLING. LESS ORGANIZED AND SLOWER MOVING STORMS PERSIST ACROSS WRN/CNTRL SD IN WATCH 362. WHILE FORCING FOR ASCENT AND SUFFICIENT INSTABILITY WILL LIKELY PERMIT THESE STORMS TO PERSIST...GENERALLY WEAK DEEP-LAYER SHEAR SHOULD LIMIT ORGANIZATION AND SEVERE POTENTIAL OVERNIGHT.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SEVERE STORM POTENTIAL HAS DECREASED ACROSS THE WATCH AREA LATE THIS EVENING AND EXPECT THE WATCH WILL LIKELY BE CANCELED PRIOR TO SCHEDULED EXPIRATION AT 0600 UTC/1AM CDT.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: ONLY ISOLATED STRONG STORMS EXIST ACROSS PARTS OF WEST TX AMIDST AN AXIS OF STRONG INSTABILITY BUT CONSIDERABLE INHIBITION DUE TO VERY WARM AIR ALOFT. LARGE SCALE ASCENT ASSOCIATED WITH WEAK MID-LEVEL HEIGHT FALLS LIKELY AIDED EARLIER ATTEMPTS A MORE ROBUST STORMS WITH A FEW ISOLATED UPDRAFTS CONTINUING EAST OF THE CAP ROCK AND ACROSS THE TRANS-PECOS. WITH THE THREAT FOR MORE ORGANIZED STORMS DIMINISHING...THE WATCH WILL LIKELY BE CANCELED PRIOR TO EXPIRATION.
